name: marketpulse
description: Root manifest for the Vercel deployment: installs the API's runtime dependencies and builds the React frontend

scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend

//: These are the dependencies of the Express app in backend/src. Vercel builds serverless functions from the repository root, so it installs from this file rather than backend/package.json. The versions are kept identical to backend/package.json so local and deployed runs execute the same code.
